questions.question: 高血压合并糖尿病患者的平均 HbA1c 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_hba1c FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%hypertension%' AND p.disease_tags LIKE '%diabetes%' AND l.item_name = 'hba1c';

questions.question: 糖尿病患者的空腹血糖平均值是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_fasting_glucose FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%diabetes%' AND l.item_name = 'fasting_glucose';

questions.question: 高脂血症患者的 LDL-C 异常比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN abnormal_flag != 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS ldl_abnormal_rate FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%hyperlipidemia%' AND l.item_name = 'ldl_c';

questions.question: BMI 超标患者有多少人？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overweight_patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE bmi >= 24.0;

questions.question: 不同疾病组合患者的平均 HbA1c 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT disease_tags, ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_hba1c FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE l.item_name = 'hba1c' GROUP BY disease_tags ORDER BY avg_hba1c DESC;

questions.question: 不同风险等级患者的人数分布是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT risk_level, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_risk_score GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY patient_count DESC;

questions.question: 不同用药类别患者的指标控制情况如何？
questions.sql_template: SELECT m.drug_category, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN l.abnormal_flag = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 4) AS control_rate FROM medication_record m JOIN lab_result l ON m.patient_id = l.patient_id AND m.visit_id = l.visit_id WHERE l.item_name IN ('hba1c','fasting_glucose','ldl_c','systolic_bp') GROUP BY m.drug_category ORDER BY control_rate DESC;

questions.question: 最近 6 个月 HbA1c 异常人数趋势如何？
questions.sql_template: SELECT substr(test_date,1,7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS abnormal_patient_count FROM lab_result WHERE item_name='hba1c' AND abnormal_flag!='normal' GROUP BY substr(test_date,1,7) ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6;

questions.question: 最近 6 个月血压异常人数趋势如何？
questions.sql_template: SELECT substr(test_date,1,7) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS abnormal_patient_count FROM lab_result WHERE item_name IN ('systolic_bp','diastolic_bp') AND abnormal_flag!='normal' GROUP BY substr(test_date,1,7) ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 6;

questions.question: 不同月份高风险事件数量变化如何？
questions.sql_template: SELECT substr(created_at,1,7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS high_risk_event_count FROM risk_event WHERE event_level='high' GROUP BY substr(created_at,1,7) ORDER BY month;

questions.question: 哪些患者同时存在血糖、血压和血脂异常？
questions.sql_template: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN item_name IN ('fasting_glucose','hba1c') AND abnormal_flag!='normal' THEN 'glucose' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN item_name IN ('systolic_bp','diastolic_bp') AND abnormal_flag!='normal' THEN 'bp' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN item_name IN ('ldl_c','triglyceride','total_cholesterol','hdl_c') AND abnormal_flag!='normal' THEN 'lipid' END) AS abnormal_domains FROM lab_result GROUP BY patient_id HAVING abnormal_domains >= 3 ORDER BY patient_id LIMIT 20;

questions.question: 高风险患者常见风险因素有哪些？
questions.sql_template: SELECT risk_factors, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM patient_risk_score WHERE risk_level='high' GROUP BY risk_factors ORDER BY record_count DESC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 用药依从性差的患者中 HbA1c 异常比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.abnormal_flag!='normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS abnormal_rate FROM medication_record m JOIN lab_result l ON m.patient_id=l.patient_id AND m.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE m.adherence='irregular' AND l.item_name='hba1c';

questions.question: 未来 30 天需要随访的高风险患者有多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.patient_id) AS due_high_risk_patients FROM followup_plan fp JOIN patient_risk_score prs ON fp.patient_id=prs.patient_id AND fp.visit_id=prs.visit_id WHERE prs.risk_level='high' AND fp.followup_date <= date('now', '+30 days') AND fp.status='scheduled';

questions.question: 不同随访优先级的患者数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT priority, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM followup_plan GROUP BY priority ORDER BY patient_count DESC;

questions.question: 逾期未随访的患者有多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS overdue_patient_count FROM followup_plan WHERE status='scheduled' AND followup_date < date('now');

questions.question: 运动不足患者的 BMI 平均值是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.bmi), 2) AS avg_bmi FROM patient_profile p JOIN lifestyle_record lr ON p.patient_id=lr.patient_id WHERE lr.exercise_minutes_per_week < 120;

questions.question: 高盐饮食患者的血压异常比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.abnormal_flag!='normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS abnormal_rate FROM lifestyle_record lr JOIN lab_result l ON lr.patient_id=l.patient_id AND lr.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE lr.salt_intake_level='high' AND l.item_name IN ('systolic_bp','diastolic_bp');

questions.question: 睡眠不足患者的高风险事件数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_risk_event_count FROM lifestyle_record lr JOIN risk_event re ON lr.patient_id=re.patient_id AND lr.visit_id=re.visit_id WHERE lr.sleep_hours < 6.5 AND re.event_level='high';

questions.question: 不同风险等级患者的平均 eGFR 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT prs.risk_level, ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_egfr FROM patient_risk_score prs JOIN lab_result l ON prs.patient_id=l.patient_id AND prs.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE l.item_name='egfr' GROUP BY prs.risk_level ORDER BY avg_egfr;

questions.question: 高尿酸血症患者的平均尿酸水平是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_uric_acid FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%hyperuricemia%' AND l.item_name='uric_acid';

questions.question: 慢性肾功能异常患者的 UACR 异常比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN abnormal_flag!='normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS uacr_abnormal_rate FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%ckd_risk%' AND l.item_name='uacr';

questions.question: 脂肪肝风险患者的 ALT 平均值是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_alt FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%fatty_liver_risk%' AND l.item_name='alt';

questions.question: 冠心病风险患者使用他汀类药物的比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.drug_name IN ('atorvastatin','rosuvastatin') THEN p.patient_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id), 4) AS statin_rate FROM patient_profile p LEFT JOIN medication_record m ON p.patient_id=m.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%coronary_risk%';

questions.question: 不同药物类别对应的患者数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT drug_category, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM medication_record GROUP BY drug_category ORDER BY patient_count DESC;

questions.question: 最近一次随访中异常指标最多的患者有哪些？
questions.sql_template: WITH latest AS (SELECT patient_id, MAX(visit_date) AS latest_date FROM visit_record GROUP BY patient_id) SELECT v.patient_id, COUNT(*) AS abnormal_count FROM visit_record v JOIN latest lt ON v.patient_id=lt.patient_id AND v.visit_date=lt.latest_date JOIN lab_result l ON v.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE l.abnormal_flag!='normal' GROUP BY v.patient_id ORDER BY abnormal_count DESC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 图谱中每种实体类型的数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT entity_type, COUNT(*) AS node_count FROM graph_nodes GROUP BY entity_type ORDER BY node_count DESC;

questions.question: 图谱中每种关系类型的数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT relation_type, COUNT(*) AS edge_count FROM graph_edges GROUP BY relation_type ORDER BY edge_count DESC;

questions.question: 高风险事件最多的事件类型是什么？
questions.sql_template: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM risk_event WHERE event_level='high' GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_count DESC;

questions.question: 不同性别患者的平均 BMI 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT gender, ROUND(AVG(bmi), 2) AS avg_bmi FROM patient_profile GROUP BY gender ORDER BY avg_bmi DESC;

questions.question: 高血压患者中收缩压超过 140 的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%hypertension%' AND l.item_name='systolic_bp' AND l.item_value >= 140;

questions.question: 糖尿病患者中 HbA1c 高于 6.5 的比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.item_value >= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS hba1c_high_rate FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%diabetes%' AND l.item_name='hba1c';

questions.question: 风险评分最高的前 10 位患者是谁？
questions.sql_template: SELECT patient_id, MAX(risk_score) AS max_risk_score FROM patient_risk_score GROUP BY patient_id ORDER BY max_risk_score DESC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 不同随访状态的计划数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS plan_count FROM followup_plan GROUP BY status ORDER BY plan_count DESC;

questions.question: 使用达格列净患者的平均空腹血糖是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_fasting_glucose FROM medication_record m JOIN lab_result l ON m.patient_id=l.patient_id AND m.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE m.drug_name='dapagliflozin' AND l.item_name='fasting_glucose';

questions.question: 慢性肾病风险患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%ckd_risk%';

questions.question: 慢阻肺患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%copd%';

questions.question: 冠心病风险患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%coronary_risk%';

questions.question: 代谢综合征患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%metabolic_syndrome%';

questions.question: 慢性肾病风险患者的平均 eGFR 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_egfr FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%ckd_risk%' AND l.item_name='egfr';

questions.question: 高尿酸血症患者中尿酸高于 420 的比例是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.item_value > 420 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS uric_high_rate FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%hyperuricemia%' AND l.item_name='uric_acid';

questions.question: 慢阻肺患者的平均 FEV1/FVC 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_fev1_ratio FROM patient_profile p JOIN lab_result l ON p.patient_id=l.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%copd%' AND l.item_name='fev1_ratio';

questions.question: 未来 60 天需要随访的患者人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM followup_plan WHERE status IN ('pending','scheduled') AND followup_date BETWEEN date('now') AND date('now', '+60 day');

questions.question: 未来 15 天需要随访的高风险患者人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM followup_plan fp JOIN patient_risk_score prs ON fp.patient_id=prs.patient_id AND fp.visit_id=prs.visit_id WHERE prs.risk_level='high' AND fp.status IN ('pending','scheduled') AND fp.followup_date BETWEEN date('now') AND date('now', '+15 day');

questions.question: 未来 30 天不同优先级随访计划数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS plan_count FROM followup_plan WHERE followup_date BETWEEN date('now') AND date('now', '+30 day') GROUP BY priority ORDER BY plan_count DESC;

questions.question: 高风险患者最常见的风险事件是什么？
questions.sql_template: SELECT re.event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM risk_event re JOIN patient_risk_score prs ON re.patient_id=prs.patient_id AND re.visit_id=prs.visit_id WHERE prs.risk_level='high' GROUP BY re.event_type ORDER BY event_count DESC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 冠心病风险患者最常用的药物类别是什么？
questions.sql_template: SELECT m.drug_category, COUNT(DISTINCT m.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile p JOIN medication_record m ON p.patient_id=m.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%coronary_risk%' GROUP BY m.drug_category ORDER BY patient_count DESC;

questions.question: 高血压合并糖尿病患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%hypertension%' AND disease_tags LIKE '%diabetes%';

questions.question: 冠心病风险合并高脂血症患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%coronary_risk%' AND disease_tags LIKE '%hyperlipidemia%';

questions.question: 慢性肾病风险合并糖尿病患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile WHERE disease_tags LIKE '%ckd_risk%' AND disease_tags LIKE '%diabetes%';

questions.question: 不同疾病标签对应的患者数量 Top10 是什么？
questions.sql_template: SELECT disease_tags, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile GROUP BY disease_tags ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 不同医生建议类型的数量是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT advice_type, COUNT(*) AS advice_count FROM doctor_advice GROUP BY advice_type ORDER BY advice_count DESC;

questions.question: 高风险患者最常见的医生建议有哪些？
questions.sql_template: SELECT da.advice_content, COUNT(*) AS advice_count FROM doctor_advice da JOIN patient_risk_score prs ON da.patient_id=prs.patient_id AND da.visit_id=prs.visit_id WHERE prs.risk_level='high' GROUP BY da.advice_content ORDER BY advice_count DESC LIMIT 10;

questions.question: 运动不足患者中高风险患者有多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT prs.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM lifestyle_record lr JOIN patient_risk_score prs ON lr.patient_id=prs.patient_id AND lr.visit_id=prs.visit_id WHERE lr.exercise_minutes_per_week < 120 AND prs.risk_level='high';

questions.question: 高盐饮食患者中未来 30 天需要随访的患者有多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM lifestyle_record lr JOIN followup_plan fp ON lr.patient_id=fp.patient_id AND lr.visit_id=fp.visit_id WHERE lr.salt_intake_level='high' AND fp.status IN ('pending','scheduled') AND fp.followup_date BETWEEN date('now') AND date('now', '+30 day');

questions.question: 睡眠不足患者的人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM lifestyle_record WHERE sleep_hours < 6.5;

questions.question: 吸烟患者中慢阻肺患者有多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile p JOIN lifestyle_record lr ON p.patient_id=lr.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%copd%' AND lr.smoking_status='yes';

questions.question: 使用利尿剂患者的平均 eGFR 是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.item_value), 2) AS avg_egfr FROM medication_record m JOIN lab_result l ON m.patient_id=l.patient_id AND m.visit_id=l.visit_id WHERE m.drug_category='diuretic' AND l.item_name='egfr';

questions.question: 使用抗血小板药物患者的冠心病风险人数是多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_profile p JOIN medication_record m ON p.patient_id=m.patient_id WHERE p.disease_tags LIKE '%coronary_risk%' AND m.drug_category='antiplatelet';

questions.question: 高风险患者中未来 7 天需要随访的患者有多少？
questions.sql_template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM followup_plan fp JOIN patient_risk_score prs ON fp.patient_id=prs.patient_id AND fp.visit_id=prs.visit_id WHERE prs.risk_level='high' AND fp.status IN ('pending','scheduled') AND fp.followup_date BETWEEN date('now') AND date('now', '+7 day');
